diary: Patrick's rock is empty since he moved to the other side of the ocean. I set two plates for dinner by habit. I watched our old jellyfishing video and did not laugh.
past_dream: A month ago I dreamed I was waving from a pier and the boat kept getting smaller but never left.

facts.text: His best friend moved away three weeks ago.
Past dream: waving from a pier at a boat that never leaves.
